proposedManifest.name: Avengers: Standoff!
proposedManifest.description: Pleasant Hill looks like a town, not a prison. S.H.I.E.L.D. has given its supervillain inmates new names, new neighbors and no memory of their crimes. When those memories start coming back, Steve Rogers and Sam Wilson have a breakout on their hands. For the people who live there, getting out is only the beginning.
proposedManifest.sourceOrigin: Compiled for this project from Comic Book Herald's guide
